claim: Frontend provider and model controls are centralized in image provider catalogs, while backend validation keeps the authoritative supported-model list.

evidence.note: Provider and platform types plus provider model config shape.
Current provider catalog, models, defaults, and platform default models.
GenerationRequest validation rejects unsupported providers/models and invalid batch/reference image counts.
Backend supported model arrays mirror frontend provider choices.

claim: Image generation starts in useGeneration, crosses src/api.ts into the generate_images Tauri command, then Rust validates, dispatches providers, writes PNGs, embeds metadata, and updates local history.

evidence.note: Frontend builds the GenerationRequest from prompt, settings, options, and reference images.
Queued task execution persists settings, invokes generation, and updates returned batches.
Renderer command wrappers for generate and cancel.
Tauri command installs cancellation state and validates/optimizes the request before generation.
Backend writes output path, embeds metadata, appends history, and persists state.

claim: The prompt library uses renderer hooks/components for UX and a Rust SQLite-backed markdown index for durable prompt metadata, rendering, include resolution, and tag operations.

evidence.note: Frontend prompt library hook imports command wrappers and owns prompt save state/sort mode.
Load, autosave/flush, create, import, and library bootstrap paths.
Rust rescans markdown prompts, maintains the SQLite index, and filters search results.
Prompt rendering strips comments, extracts variables, renders prompt blocks, and resolves library includes.
User-facing storage contract: markdown bodies plus SQLite metadata.

claim: Frontend clamping is UX-only; filesystem, provider, model, batch, reference image, output template, and provider-option validation must be enforced in Rust Tauri commands and helpers.

evidence.note: Project guidance explicitly treats renderer as less trusted and calls for narrow validated Tauri commands.
Architecture notes state backend request building is the source of safety and reference images cross the frontend/backend boundary.
GenerationRequest validation enforces provider/model/batch/reference image/template rules.
File read/export command handlers route through Rust file helpers and local path handling.

claim: Frontend/UI changes should run pnpm test:frontend and pnpm build; Rust/native/provider changes should run cargo test in src-tauri; git diff --check is the common pre-commit whitespace check.

evidence.note: Project validation policy lists frontend, Rust, and diff-check gates.
Available package scripts include build, test:frontend, and typecheck.
Existing focused frontend test file covers PromptEditor search/replace behavior.
